summary: Comprehensive testing of Berlin.rent marketplace with 3 listing types (offering, looking, sharing_rent). All backend APIs and frontend features working correctly.

backend: GET /api/listings returns all 3 listing types (offering, looking, sharing_rent)
POST /api/listings creates offering listing with contact info
POST /api/listings creates looking listing with contact info
POST /api/listings creates sharing_rent listing (no contact info)
Listing structure validation for all 3 types
frontend: App loads with map and listings
3 listing types displayed with correct colors (green=offering, purple=looking, orange=sharing_rent)
Stats bar shows 4 counts (Total, Offering, Looking, Rents)
Map legend shows all 3 types (Offering, Looking, Rent Data)
No 'Pin & List' button - direct map click is used
Tap hint banner visible with correct message
Direct map click opens create modal with 3 type options
sharing_rent type has 2-step wizard (skips contact step)
offering/looking types have 3-step wizard (includes contact step)
Create flow works: click map → select type → fill details → submit
View listing modal shows correct type label and color
View listing modal shows 'Anonymous rent data — no contact info' for sharing_rent

seed_data_creation: 23 seeded listings (10 offering, 3 looking, 10 sharing_rent) + test listings created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 listing types (offering, looking, sharing_rent) are fully functional.
